replay: Create the deployment with the above settings through Deployments > New Deployment; verify Saved and Planned.
Add the van with CS-VAN-1, add Casey to that unit with CS-1 and no seat override, then add Demo radio kit as free-text equipment attached to the same unit.
In Time reports choose the date and Crew scope, create the daily report, update the three roster rows and add the separate personnel Travel row.
Use Save; verify the four saved hours and the3.5personnel-hour summary. The new report ID/number may differ when replayed.
In the daily report add the fictional Fuel expense with the supplied receipt; clear Billable, save, then inspect Expenses on the deployment for Not billable, its amount and the report link.
After retaining the time/expense source captures, use the Return arrow on Demo radio kit and verify No equipment rostered while Casey and the van remain assigned.
In Files upload the supplied handover note as Other, verify the saved display name and filename, then use View manifest and review the current unit/personnel assignments.
